common:generalComment.#text: 本数据集描述了＜1kV低压交流电的产品流，从电力生产、传输到最终供应给使用电力的用户。该数据集专为用户侧的电力使用而设计，反映了多种电力来源的混合，包括化石燃料、核能和可再生能源等不同发电方式的组合。数据集符合国际生命周期数据系统 (ILCD) 的相关规定，满足方法学、数据质量、命名规范、审核和文档等方面的要求，确保数据的准确性和适用性，特别是针对电力用户的环境影响评估。

This dataset describes the product flow of low voltage alternating current (LVAC) electricity from ＜1kV, from the production and transmission of the electricity to its final supply to the consumers who use it. The dataset is designed for customer-side electricity use and reflects a mix of multiple electricity sources, including a combination of different generation methods such as fossil fuels, nuclear and renewable energy. The dataset is compliant with the International Life Cycle Data (ILCD) system and meets methodology, data quality, naming conventions, auditing and documentation requirements to ensure accuracy and applicability of the data, particularly for environmental impact assessment of electricity users.

common:generalComment.#text: 聚丙烯（Polypropylene，简称PP）是一种半结晶热塑性塑料，具有较高的抗冲击性、良好的机械性能，并可耐受多种有机溶剂及酸碱腐蚀。其工业用途广泛，包括包装材料、标签和纺织品。聚丙烯在一定温度范围内熔融，因此通常以差示扫描量热曲线的峰值温度确定熔点。完全等规聚丙烯的熔点为171℃；商业等规聚丙烯的熔点通常为160–166℃，具体取决于无规立构组分含量和结晶度；结晶度为30%的间规聚丙烯熔点为130℃。

Polypropylene (PP) is a semi-crystalline thermoplastic with relatively high impact resistance, robust mechanical properties, and resistance to many organic solvents, acids and alkalis. It is widely used in industry, including in packaging materials, labels and textiles. Polypropylene melts over a temperature range, so its melting point is commonly determined from the peak temperature of a differential scanning calorimetry curve. Perfectly isotactic polypropylene has a melting point of 171 °C. Commercial isotactic polypropylene generally melts at 160–166 °C, depending on its atactic fraction and crystallinity. Syndiotactic polypropylene with 30% crystallinity has a melting point of 130 °C.

common:generalComment.#text: Health and Medical Supplies refer to the stockpile of medicines and medical supplies used in public health emergencies. They include items required for home medical care, such as orthopedic needs and diabetic testing supplies. Medical supply companies offer a wide range of condition-specific products. Durable medical equipment (DME) refers to medically necessary items for people with medical conditions, disabilities, or injuries, including mobility gear and healthcare devices.
健康和医疗用品指的是用于公共卫生紧急情况的药品和医疗用品储备。它们包括家庭医疗护理所需的物品，如骨科需求和糖尿病测试用品。医疗供应公司提供各种针对特定病症的产品。耐用医疗设备（DME）指的是医疗病症、残疾或受伤的人所需的医疗必需品，包括移动设备和医疗设备。

common:generalComment.#text: Tap water refers to water that has been processed for safety and compliance with drinking water standards and is commonly supplied to households and industries via plumbing systems. It is treated to remove contaminants and pathogens, typically involving processes such as filtration, sedimentation, and disinfection. This water is ready for direct consumption or use in various applications 'to consumer' and 'at plant'. The specific treatment methods and quality can vary depending on the location and local water source.
自来水指的是经过处理，符合饮用水标准的水，通常通过管道系统供应给家庭和工业。它经过处理去除污染物和病原体，通常包括过滤、沉淀和消毒等过程。这种水可以直接饮用或用于各种应用，‘对消费者’和‘在工厂’。具体的处理方法和水质可能因地点和当地水源而异。

common:generalComment.#text: Cotton is a seed-hair fibre of several species of plants of the genus Gossypium, belonging to the hibiscus, or mallow, family (Malvaceae). It is one of the world's leading agricultural crops, plentiful and economically produced. Cotton is a soft, fluffy staple fiber that grows in a boll, or protective case, around the seeds of the cotton plants. It is a staple textile of the fashion industry and the most widely produced natural fiber on the planet.
棉花是属于木槿或锦葵科（锦葵属）的棉属植物中多个品种的籽毛纤维。它是世界主要农作物之一，产量丰富且经济实惠。棉花是一种柔软、蓬松的短纤维，生长在棉铃或棉花种子周围的保护壳中。它是时装业的主要纺织品，也是地球上生产最广泛的天然纤维。

common:generalComment.#text: Hydraulic fluid's main function in hydraulic systems is to transmit power from one part of a system to another. It converts mechanical energy into hydraulic pressure, which is uniformly distributed throughout the fluid. The pressure can move pistons or cylinders, which in turn move other parts of the system. Hydraulic fluid is a non-compressible, engineered medium that provides lubrication and heat and power transfer properties. It is composed of a base oil, which can be mineral or synthetic, along with various performance-enhancing additives.
液压流体在液压系统中的主要功能是将动力从系统的一个部分传递到另一个部分。它将机械能转化为液压，液压均匀分布在整个流体中。压力可以移动活塞或气缸，进而移动系统的其他部分。液压流体是一种不可压缩的工程介质，具有润滑、传热和动力传递特性。它由矿物油或合成基础油以及各种性能增强添加剂组成。

common:generalComment.#text: Polyethylene is a plastic film made from ethylene, a hydrocarbon mainly obtained from natural gas or oil. It is commonly used in packaging for pharmaceuticals, household chemicals, and food items. There are different types of polyethylene film, influenced by the degree and form of side branching from the polymer chain. Polyethylene terephthalates are solid forms of polyester, and rival polyethylene in packaging applications.
聚乙烯是一种由乙烯制成的塑料薄膜，乙烯是一种碳氢化合物，主要从天然气或石油中提取。它常用于药品、家用化学品和食品的包装。聚乙烯薄膜有不同的类型，受聚合物链的侧枝程度和形式的影响。聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯是聚酯的固态形式，在包装应用中可与聚乙烯相媲美。
